fields.name: mass

fields.name: linear_damping

fields.name: angular_damping

fields.name: gravity_scale

fields.name: constraints
fields.doc: Frozen axes, Unity's `RigidbodyConstraints` bits (dynamic bodies; see [`constraints`]): 2/4/8 freeze the position along X/Y/Z, 16/32/64 the rotation about X/Y/Z, 0 none.

records.name: fynkel.Collider
records.doc: A collision shape on the entity, in the entity's local frame scaled by the entity's world scale. Alone it is static geometry; with a `RigidBody` it is that body's shape.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Metres; what each component means depends on `shape`.

fields.name: mesh

fields.name: offset

fields.name: restitution
fields.doc: Bounciness `0..=1`; ignored when `material` names one.

fields.name: is_sensor
fields.doc: A sensor reports trigger events and applies no forces.

fields.name: mask
fields.doc: Which layers this collider collides with (bit `i` = the project's `layers[i]`; both sides must agree). Its own layer is its entity's `fynkel.Layer` (ADR-0020).

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Used by `setKinematicTarget` and `teleport`; identity otherwise.

Colliders are candidates when their `layer` shares a bit with `mask`; the `exclude` entity's colliders are skipped; sensors are hit only with `hit_sensors`.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Echoed by every hit of this query.

fields.name: shape

fields.name: rotation

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: `raycast`/`shapeCast`; need not be normalised.

fields.name: max_hits

records.name: fynkel.rec.PhysicsHit

records.name: fynkel.rec.BodyState
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_BODY`: the motion state of an entity's `fynkel.RigidBody` (`MISSING_COMPONENT` without one).

records.name: fynkel.rec.EntityInfo
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_ENTITIES` (M3-08b): one per live entity, entity order — its parent (`NULL` at the root), name (empty without one), layer index (0 without a `fynkel.Layer`), tag bits (0 without a `fynkel.Tags`, ADR-0020) and its own active flag (`activeSelf`; the hierarchy's is derived from the parents). What `World.find`/`findAll`/`findChild`/`findWithTag` read, one query per tick.

records.name: fynkel.CharacterController
records.doc: A kinematic capsule walked by gameplay (blueprint §19.2d item 9, over Rapier's kinematic character controller). The entity's origin is the capsule's centre minus `center` — with the default `center` the origin is at the feet. Moved by `move`/`jump` commands (one `move` per tick; no command is standing still) or, with `move_action`/`jump_action` named, by the runtime itself from those actions (walking relative to the `fynkel.ThirdPersonCamera` that targets the entity, if any). Slopes up to `max_slope` are climbed, steeper ones slid down; steps up to `max_step_height` are climbed; gravity accumulates while airborne and the character snaps to ground within `snap_to_ground`. Ground contact, sliding and the effective velocity are held state (`characterState()`). Its own kinematic capsule replaces any `RigidBody`/`Collider` on the entity (`FYN-H0006`), collides by its object's `fynkel.Layer` and its `mask`, reports contact and trigger events and pushes dynamic bodies as a body of `mass` kilograms would.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Capsule radius, metres, `> 0`.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Total capsule height (both caps included), `>= 2 * radius`.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: The capsule's centre in the entity's local frame (scaled by the entity's scale, like a collider offset).

fields.name: skin_width
fields.doc: Skin the controller keeps from geometry, metres, `>= 0`.

fields.name: max_slope
fields.doc: Steepest climbable slope, radians in `0..pi/2`; steeper ground slides the character down.

fields.name: max_step_height
fields.doc: Highest step climbed without a jump, metres (`0` disables).

fields.name: snap_to_ground
fields.doc: How far below the feet ground still counts as touched when walking off a bump, metres (`0` disables).

fields.name: gravity_scale
fields.doc: Multiplies the world's gravity; `0` is a flying character whose `move` velocity is used in full (vertical included).

fields.name: mass
fields.doc: Kilograms the character pushes dynamic bodies with (`0` pushes nothing).

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: Walk speed of the runtime driver (`move_action`), m/s.

fields.name: jump_speed
fields.doc: Take-off speed of a `jump` without an explicit speed, m/s.

fields.name: turn_speed
fields.doc: Radians per second the entity turns towards its horizontal motion (`0` leaves the rotation to gameplay).

fields.name: move_action
fields.doc: A 2D action walked by the runtime every tick at `speed` (x right, y forward, relative to the camera that targets this entity); empty leaves movement to `move` commands.

fields.name: jump_action
fields.doc: A button action whose press jumps when grounded; empty leaves it to `jump` commands.

fields.name: mask
fields.doc: Which layers the capsule collides with and walks on (bit `i` = the project's `layers[i]`); its own layer is its entity's `fynkel.Layer` (ADR-0020).

records.name: fynkel.ThirdPersonCamera
records.doc: A camera rig that orbits a target (blueprint §19.2d item 9: `Follow` specialised for the third person). Every tick, after physics, the entity is placed `distance` metres from the target's world position + `pivot` at `yaw`/`pitch` (radians; yaw 0 is behind the target on +Z, pitch positive above it looking down) and turned to look at the pivot; with a `look_action` named, that 2D action turns the rig at `sensitivity` radians per second per unit of input (x turns the view right, y up) between `min_pitch` and `max_pitch`; `yaw`/`pitch` are written back so gameplay reads (and may set) them. With `collision_radius > 0` a sphere of that radius is cast from the pivot towards the rig against `mask` (the target's own colliders excluded) and the rig pulls in to the hit, never closer than `min_distance`. The target is named (`fynkel.Name`, the first match in entity order); an empty or unknown name leaves the entity where it is.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The followed entity's name; empty follows nothing.

fields.name: pivot
fields.doc: Offset from the target's world position the rig looks at and orbits, metres.

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: Orbit radius, metres, `> 0`.

fields.name: min_distance
fields.doc: Closest the pull-in brings the rig, metres, `0..=distance`.

fields.name: yaw
fields.doc: Orbit yaw, radians (state).

fields.name: pitch
fields.doc: Orbit elevation, radians (state), kept in `min_pitch..=max_pitch`.

fields.name: look_action
fields.doc: A 2D action that turns the rig; empty leaves yaw/pitch to gameplay.

fields.name: sensitivity
fields.doc: Radians per second per unit of `look_action` input.

fields.name: collision_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the pull-in sphere cast, metres (`0` disables).

fields.name: mask
fields.doc: Layers the pull-in cast hits.

records.name: fynkel.rec.CharacterState
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_CHARACTER` (M3-09): a `fynkel.CharacterController`'s held state as the last step left it (no record without one).

fields.name: grounded
fields.doc: Standing on ground no steeper than `max_slope`.

fields.name: sliding
fields.doc: Touching a slope steeper than `max_slope` (sliding down it).

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc: The movement applied over the last tick, metres per second.

fields.name: collision_flags
fields.doc: Where the last move touched something (Unity's `CollisionFlags`): 1 sides, 2 above, 4 below.

records.name: fynkel.Rotator
records.doc: Spins the entity about `axis` at `speed` radians per second, every tick, in the pre-tick slot (blueprint §3.5 catalogue, M3-10). A `RigidBody` on the same entity follows as a kinematic target.

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: Spin axis, normalised at use; must not be zero.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: Radians per second (negative spins the other way).

records.name: fynkel.Oscillate
records.doc: Moves the entity back and forth along `axis`: its position is the rest position plus `axis · amplitude · sin(2π · frequency · t + phase)`, where `t` starts at 0 when the component is added and the rest position is wherever the entity is when nothing else moves it — a transform write from gameplay shifts the rest position, it does not fight the oscillation. Pre-tick slot; a kinematic `RigidBody` on the entity rides along (a moving platform).

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: Direction of travel, normalised at use; must not be zero.

fields.name: amplitude
fields.doc: Metres either side of the rest position, `>= 0`.

fields.name: frequency
fields.doc: Cycles per second, `>= 0`.

fields.name: phase
fields.doc: Radians into the cycle at `t = 0`.

records.name: fynkel.Follow
records.doc: Keeps the entity at a named entity's world position plus `offset`, after the tick's physics, optionally turned to look at it. With `smoothing` 0 it snaps; otherwise it closes the gap at that rate per second (`1 − e^(−smoothing·dt)` of the distance per tick), the usual exponential follow. The target is named (`fynkel.Name`, the first match in entity order); an empty or unknown name leaves the entity where it is. A camera follows with `ThirdPersonCamera` instead.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The followed entity's name; empty follows nothing.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Metres from the target's world position, world axes.

fields.name: smoothing
fields.doc: Per second, `>= 0`; `0` snaps.

fields.name: look_at
fields.doc: Also turn the entity's -Z towards the target's position.

records.name: fynkel.LookAtCamera
records.doc: Turns the entity so its local +Z faces the active camera (the enabled `Camera` with the highest priority, lowest entity on a tie), after the tick's physics and camera rigs: a billboard. A quad authored in its XY plane faces the viewer.

fields.name: lock_y
fields.doc: Turn about the world Y axis only, staying upright (a tree card); `false` also tilts to face a camera above or below.

records.name: fynkel.LifetimeDespawn
records.doc: Destroys the entity and its subtree `seconds` after the component is added (pre-tick slot; `Destroyed` events as for `Command::Destroy`). `seconds` counts down and reads as the time left.

fields.name: seconds
fields.doc: Seconds left, `>= 0`.

records.name: fynkel.Emitter
records.doc: Instantiates `prefab` at the entity's world pose `rate` times per second (pre-tick slot; the fractional remainder carries over so 2.5/s alternates 2 and 3 per second): each instance is the prefab's root, unparented and named after the prefab, with the prefab's other entities under it — exactly `World::instantiate` — with a `LifetimeDespawn { seconds: lifetime }` on the root when `lifetime > 0`, and every dynamic `RigidBody` in it starts at `velocity` (world axes). With `max_alive > 0` no more are spawned while that many of this emitter's instances live. The world must know the prefab (`World::register_prefab`; the loaders register every prefab a loaded scene's emitters name, `PREFAB_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).

fields.name: prefab
fields.doc: The `.prefab.json` asset to instantiate.

fields.name: rate
fields.doc: Instances per second, `>= 0`; `0` pauses.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.doc: Seconds each instance lives, `>= 0`; `0` keeps them.

fields.name: max_alive
fields.doc: Ceiling on this emitter's live instances; `0` is unlimited.

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc: Initial linear velocity of each instance's dynamic bodies, m/s.

records.name: fynkel.rec.SystemTime
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_SYSTEMS` (M3-10): one per [`SystemKind`], the last step's wall time and the number of things that phase touched. What the HUD and the headless report print as per-system time.

fields.name: micros
fields.doc: Microseconds of wall time in the last step.

records.name: fynkel.TriggerZone
records.doc: Names the event Dart hears when a collider enters or leaves this entity's **sensor** `Collider` (M3-12; `docs/scenes.md`): every physics `TriggerEnter`/`TriggerExit` the entity takes part in also produces a general-lane `ZoneEntered`/`ZoneExited` event carrying `event`, the zone entity and the other one, so gameplay subscribes by name (`world.zones.on('collect', …)`) instead of matching colliders. With `once` the component is removed right after the first entry (no exit follows; the collider stays until the entity goes). An entity without a sensor collider never fires (`fynkel validate`: `FYN-H0009`).

fields.name: event
fields.doc: The event name, non-empty.

fields.name: once
fields.doc: Fire on the first entry only, then drop the component.

records.name: fynkel.ev.SceneUnloaded
records.doc: A scene was unloaded (M3-12): its still-alive entities were destroyed (their `Destroyed` events precede this one) and the host released its asset residency.

fields.name: entities
fields.doc: Entities destroyed by the unload.

records.name: fynkel.ev.Zone
records.doc: A `fynkel.TriggerZone` fired (M3-12): the body of `ZONE_ENTERED` (7) and `ZONE_EXITED` (8), on the general lane the tick the sensor saw it.

fields.name: zone
fields.doc: The entity carrying the `TriggerZone`.

fields.name: other
fields.doc: The collider that entered or left.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: The zone's `event` name.

fields.name: master_volume
fields.doc: Gain of the `master` bus, `0..=1`.

fields.name: music_volume
fields.doc: Gain of the `music` bus, `0..=1`.

fields.name: sfx_volume
fields.doc: Gain of the `sfx` bus, `0..=1`.

fields.name: muted
fields.doc: Every bus silent; the volumes are kept.

fields.name: quality
fields.doc: A quality profile name from the project file; empty means the project's default profile.

records.name: fynkel.rec.ProjectionAnchor
records.doc: One anchor of a projection request (`fynkel_world_project`, M3-13, blueprint §10): a point `offset` from the entity's origin in its local frame, projected into the viewport the request names. `mask` (collider layers) enables the explicit occlusion policy: a raycast from the camera to the point that hits a collider on those layers first marks the anchor `OCCLUDED`; 0 tests nothing.

records.name: fynkel.rec.ProjectedPoint
records.doc: The answer to one `fynkel.rec.ProjectionAnchor`, in request order: `x`/`y` in the requested viewport's pixels (origin top-left, y down), `depth` metres in front of the camera along its view axis, `flags` the `PROJECTED_*` bits (`fynkel_core::projection`). `x`/`y` are meaningful only with `PROJECTED_IN_FRONT`.

records.name: fynkel.Animator
records.doc: Plays one clip over the entity's subtree (M3-19, `docs/animation.md`): every channel of `clip` drives the first descendant (the entity itself included) named like the channel's target, in the pre-tick slot, so physics and the catalogue see the posed transforms this tick. `speed` scales time (negative plays backwards); a `looping` clip wraps, one that is not stops at its last key with `playing` cleared and an `ANIMATION_ENDED` event. `Command::Animate` plays, crossfades, stops, pauses, resumes, re-speeds and seeks it from Dart; the world must know the clip (`World::register_clip`; the loaders register every clip a loaded scene's animators name, `CLIP_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).  Layers (M3-19c): a second animator on a descendant is a layer over the first — animators apply ancestor-first, so the deeper one owns the entities its clip names (a mask by placement: an `Animator` on the spine drives the upper body over the one on the root). `weight` blends its pose over what is under it (`0` leaves it untouched), `additive` adds the clip's difference from its first frame instead of replacing the pose (a wave over a walk). `root_motion` takes the planar translation and yaw of the clip's root channel out of the pose and publishes the per-tick delta: a `CharacterController` on the entity walks by it, else the entity's own transform moves.  ADR-0032: with a `controller` (an Animator Controller, `.controller.json`) the animator runs its state machine instead and `clip` and `looping` are not used; `speed`, `playing`, `weight` and `root_motion` still apply to the whole animator.

fields.name: clip
fields.doc: The clip (an imported glTF `anim/<a>` sub-asset or a blend space `.blend.json`); nil plays nothing.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: Playback rate, `1` is authored speed; finite.

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: Blend weight of this animator's pose over the pose beneath it, in `[0, 1]`; `1` (the default) replaces it.

fields.name: additive
fields.doc: Add the clip's delta from its first frame instead of replacing.

fields.name: root_motion
fields.doc: Extract the root channel's planar motion (see above).

fields.name: controller
fields.doc: The Animator Controller it runs (ADR-0032); none plays `clip`.

records.name: fynkel.Skin
records.doc: Makes the entity's `MeshRenderer` a skinned draw (M3-19): the mesh's vertices carry joint weights into `skin` (an imported glTF `skin/<s>`), whose joints are resolved by name to entities under the one named `skeleton` — searched from the mesh entity's tree root, the root itself when `skeleton` is empty. Every frame the renderer gets one matrix per joint from those entities' (interpolated) world matrices; a joint that does not resolve stays in its bind pose. The importer writes this next to the renderer of every skinned node; the world must know the skin (`World::register_skin`; loaders do, `SKIN_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).

fields.name: skin
fields.doc: The skin sub-asset.

fields.name: skeleton
fields.doc: Name of the skeleton root entity; empty for the tree root.

records.name: fynkel.cmd.Animate
records.doc: Drives a `fynkel.Animator` (M3-19; simulation lane only). Rejected at the tick with `MISSING_COMPONENT` (no animator) or `INVALID_PAYLOAD` (non-finite value, negative fade, a weight outside `[0, 1]`, an empty parameter name; ADR-0032: a clip op on an animator that runs a controller, a controller op on one that does not, a parameter or state the controller does not have, a value of another type).

fields.name: seconds
fields.doc: Fade length for `crossfade`, the target time for `setTime`.

fields.name: speed
fields.doc: Playback rate for `play`/`crossfade`/`setSpeed`.

fields.name: looping
fields.doc: For `play`/`crossfade`.

fields.name: clip
fields.doc: For `play`/`crossfade`.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: The weight for `setWeight`, the parameter value for `setParameter`/`setFloat`/`setBool`, the start fraction for `playState`/`crossFadeState`, the blend out for `playOneShot`/`stopOneShot`, the weight for `setIkTarget`.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The parameter name for `setParameter` and the typed setters, the state name for `playState`/`crossFadeState`, the slot for `playOneShot`/`stopOneShot`, the goal for `setIkTarget`/ `clearIkTarget`.

fields.name: integer
fields.doc: The value for `setInteger` (ADR-0032).

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: The layer for `playState`/`crossFadeState`; `-1` is the first layer with a state of that name.

fields.name: point
fields.doc: The target for `setIkTarget`, in world space (ADR-0033 § 5).

records.name: fynkel.ev.AnimationEnded
records.doc: A `fynkel.Animator`'s non-looping clip reached its end (M3-19): the body of `ANIMATION_ENDED` (9), general lane, the tick it happened; `playing` is cleared the same tick.

records.name: fynkel.rec.AnimatorState
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_ANIMATOR` (M3-19): a `fynkel.Animator`'s playback state as the last step left it (no record without one).

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Seconds into the clip.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: The clip's length; `0` while the clip is unknown to the world.

fields.name: fade_remaining
fields.doc: Seconds left of a crossfade, `0` when none is running.

fields.name: clip
fields.doc: The clip being played.

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: The layer weight (M3-19c).

fields.name: parameter
fields.doc: The value of the parameter a playing blend space reads, `0` for a clip (M3-19c).

fields.name: root_delta
fields.doc: Root motion taken out of the pose over the last tick, in the entity's parent space (M3-19c); zero without `rootMotion`.

fields.name: root_yaw
fields.doc: Root yaw taken out over the last tick, radians (M3-19c).

records.name: fynkel.ev.AnimationMarker
records.doc: An animator's clock crossed a clip marker (M3-19c): the body of `ANIMATION_MARKER` (10), general lane, once per crossing — a loop crosses every marker every lap, a negative speed crosses them backwards, a fading clip's markers are not raised.

fields.name: clip
fields.doc: The clip whose marker it is (a blend space's dominant clip).

records.name: fynkel.AudioSource
records.doc: A clip with its playback settings on the entity. `playing: true` in a scene starts the clip when the scene loads (like an `Animator`); the world clears it when a non-looping clip ends (`PLAYBACK_ENDED`). A behaviour drives it with the `Audio` command (`play`, `stop`, `pause`, `resume`, `setVolume`, `setPitch`) or by writing the component: a changed `volume`/`pitch`/`looping` reaches the playing voice at the next tick, a changed `playing` starts or stops it. The clip must be an audio source the world was given (`World::register_sound`; the loaders register every clip a loaded scene's sources name, `SOUND_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).

fields.name: clip
fields.doc: The audio asset (a `.wav`/`.ogg` source; no sub-asset).

fields.name: volume
fields.doc: Linear gain, `0..=1`.

fields.name: pitch
fields.doc: Playback rate multiplier, `MIN_PITCH..=MAX_PITCH`; `1` is the clip's own rate.

fields.name: playing
fields.doc: Whether the clip is playing (authored `true`: from the load).

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Who keeps a voice when the voice limit is reached: a new sound steals the voice of the lowest-priority sound at or below its own priority (the oldest among equals) and is refused when every voice outranks it.

records.name: fynkel.AudioListener
records.doc: Where the ears are. Tier 1 plays everything as 2D, so the listener is a gain over every voice (`0..=1`; fade the world out on a death) and the place spatial audio (M5) will measure from. One per world: the lowest-numbered entity with one is the listener; without one the world still plays at gain 1.

fields.name: volume
fields.doc: Linear gain over everything, `0..=1`.

records.name: fynkel.cmd.Audio
records.doc: Drives a `fynkel.AudioSource` (M3-11; simulation lane only). Rejected at the tick with `MISSING_COMPONENT` (no source) or `INVALID_PAYLOAD` (a value outside its rule).

fields.name: value
fields.doc: The volume for `setVolume`, the pitch for `setPitch`.

records.name: fynkel.cmd.PlaySound
records.doc: Plays a clip once on no entity (M3-11; either lane): a fire-and-forget sound — no `PLAYBACK_ENDED`, no handle. `SOUND_UNAVAILABLE` at the tick for a clip the world has not been given; refused silently under the voice limit (`fynkel.rec.AudioStats.refused` counts).

records.name: fynkel.cmd.AudioBus
records.doc: Sets a bus gain and the mute (M3-11; either lane): what the `fynkel.Settings` volumes are applied through. `master` scales the other two; `muted` silences everything.

records.name: fynkel.ev.PlaybackEnded
records.doc: A `fynkel.AudioSource`'s non-looping clip reached its end (M3-11): the body of `PLAYBACK_ENDED` (11), general lane, the tick it happened; `playing` is cleared the same tick. A stopped or stolen voice raises nothing.

records.name: fynkel.rec.AudioState
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_AUDIO` (M3-11): a `fynkel.AudioSource`'s playback state as the last step left it (no record without one).

fields.name: playing
fields.doc: The source has a voice (paused or not).

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Seconds into the clip.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: The clip's length; `0` while the clip is unknown to the world.

fields.name: voice
fields.doc: The voice handle (`generation << 8 | slot`), `0` without one.

records.name: fynkel.rec.AudioStats
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_AUDIO_STATS` (M3-11): the world's audio engine at a glance — the device (or the null backend), the voices in use and the counters since the world was created.

fields.name: device
fields.doc: A real output device is open (else the null backend).

fields.name: voices
fields.doc: Voices playing now.

fields.name: clips
fields.doc: Clips registered.

fields.name: callbacks
fields.doc: Device callbacks (or null renders) so far.

fields.name: underruns
fields.doc: Device underruns reported by the backend.

fields.name: streams
fields.doc: Streamed clips registered (M3-11 part 2: decoded as they play).

fields.name: starved
fields.doc: Callbacks in which a streamed voice's decoder had fallen behind.

records.name: fynkel.Volume
records.doc: A post-processing volume (R3a, `docs/renderer.md` § Volumes): the look overrides in `profile` (a `.volume.json`) applied to the frame by how far inside the shape the camera is. Every frame the renderer starts from the engine defaults and blends the enabled volumes over them in `priority` order (ties: scene order), each by `weight` × its shape's factor — 1 inside, falling linearly to 0 at `blend_distance` outside. The project's quality profile stays the ceiling: a volume cannot turn on what the profile has off.

fields.name: profile
fields.doc: The `.volume.json` profile.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: A box's full size in the entity's local units, each `> 0`.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: A sphere's radius in the entity's local units, `> 0`.

fields.name: blend_distance
fields.doc: Metres outside the shape over which the volume fades out, `>= 0`.

fields.name: weight
fields.doc: How much of the profile applies, `0..=1`.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Higher priorities blend over lower ones.

records.name: fynkel.Layer
records.doc: The object's layer (ADR-0020): an index into the project's `layers` (at most 32), used by physics (a collider's membership is `1 << layer`), by cameras' and lights' culling masks and by queries. An entity without one is on layer 0, `default`.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: `0..32`: the project's `layers[layer]`.

records.name: fynkel.Tags
records.doc: The object's tags (ADR-0020): bit `i` is the project's `tags[i]` (at most 32 — a document number stays exact, and a web client can hold the set). An entity without one has no tags.

fields.name: bits
fields.doc: Bit `i` set: the object carries the project's `tags[i]`.

records.name: fynkel.cmd.SetActive
records.doc: Sets the entity's own active flag (`GameObject.setActive`): an inactive subtree is not drawn, simulated, animated or heard. Simulation lane only.

records.name: fynkel.ev.AnimatorStateEntered
records.doc: A layer of an Animator Controller entered a state (ADR-0032): the body of `ANIMATOR_STATE_ENTERED` (12), general lane — on the first tick (the default state, `from` empty), when a transition fires, and for a `playState`/`crossFadeState`. The state is entered when its crossfade starts.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: The layer's index in the controller (0 is the base layer).

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The state left; empty on the first tick.

records.name: fynkel.ev.AnimatorStateExited
records.doc: A layer of an Animator Controller stopped playing a state (ADR-0032): the body of `ANIMATOR_STATE_EXITED` (13), general lane, when its crossfade out ended (the tick of a transition without one).

records.name: fynkel.rec.AnimatorLayerState
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_ANIMATOR_CONTROLLER` (ADR-0032): one record per layer of the controller an animator runs, as the last step left it (Unity's `GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo` / `GetNextAnimatorStateInfo`). No records for an animator without a running controller.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: The state playing; during a crossfade the one fading out.

fields.name: normalized_time
fields.doc: Its normalized time: 1.5 = halfway through the second loop.

fields.name: length
fields.doc: Its motion's length, seconds (`0` for no motion).

fields.name: next
fields.doc: During a crossfade: the state faded to; empty otherwise.

fields.name: transition_progress
fields.doc: How far the crossfade is, 0 → 1; `0` without one.

fields.name: slot
fields.doc: The layer's slot (ADR-0033 § 2): its name, the layer's.

fields.name: one_shot
fields.doc: The one-shot playing in it (not one blending out after a stop); nil for none.

fields.name: one_shot_time
fields.doc: Its normalized time, 0 → 1.

fields.name: one_shot_weight
fields.doc: How much of it shows, 0 → 1.

records.name: fynkel.rec.AnimatorParameter
records.doc: `FYNKEL_QUERY_ANIMATOR_PARAMETERS` (ADR-0032): one record per parameter of the controller an animator runs, in the controller's order. No records for an animator without a running controller.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: A float's value (an int's and a bool's as a number too).

fields.name: integer
fields.doc: An int's value.

fields.name: flag
fields.doc: A bool's or a trigger's value.
